title: Performance of Neural Operator Baselines on 'The Well' Dataset
abstract: arXiv:2610.33967v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The Well, a 15-terabyte dataset spanning 16 physical simulation domains, provides an extensive benchmark for developing and evaluating machine learning surrogate models for complex physical systems. The baselines released with the benchmark were presented by their authors as illustrative examples obtained at small computational cost, trained with zero to very limited hyperparameter tuning and under a highly constraining 12-hour per-run wall-clock limit. These results have subsequently been treated as fully tuned benchmarks, and in some cases effectively interpreted as unconstrained performance baselines. We perform a short non-exhaustive hyperparameter search for the Tucker-factorized Fourier Neural Operator (TFNO) under the same 12-hour per-run wall-clock limit, while using only a single input timestep rather than the history of up to four used by the published baselines. translated_title: “The Well”数据集上神经算子基线的性能表现
translated_abstract: The Well是一个15TB的数据集，涵盖16个物理模拟领域，为开发和评估针对复杂物理系统的机器学习代理模型提供了广泛的基准。随该基准一同发布的基础模型（基线）由其作者作为示例性结果呈现，这些结果在极低计算成本下获得，训练时几乎没有进行超参数调优，并受到每次运行12小时墙钟时间的严格限制。然而，这些结果随后被当作完全调优过的基准，在某些情况下甚至被实际解读为不受约束的性能基线。我们在相同的每次运行12小时墙钟时间限制下，对Tucker分解傅里叶神经算子（TFNO）进行了简短且非穷尽的超参数搜索，同时仅使用单个输入时间步，而已发布的基线则使用了最多四个时间步的历史信息。尽管在这种更为受限的设置下，仅通过调优本身就能显著降低VRMSE……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 本文在相同的12小时计算限制下、且仅使用单个输入时间步的更苛刻条件下，对TFNO进行简单超参数调优即可显著优于“The Well”基准已发布的基线结果，说明原基线因调优不足而被低估，不应被视作性能上限。
en_tdlr: Under the same 12-hour wall-clock limit and with only a single input timestep, a brief hyperparameter search for TFNO substantially outperforms the published baselines on "The Well", showing that the original baseline results were under-tuned and should not be treated as performance ceilings.
